humanReview.verdict: Accept as candidate kit v0 with warnings
warnings: Canopy masses still read as generic green blobs.
Trunk material language is still simple.
Root clusters may need better ground integration during scatter.
Isolated preview does not validate route-camera quality.
humanReview.decision: Acceptable as a candidate kit for MYB-148 / MYB-150 route-camera testing. Do not keep polishing in Blender unless required by validator ERROR.
